claims.claim: The paper reports lightweight ASR accuracy and resource results for the proposed framework.
claims.limitations: Hardware, language, model family, data, latency measurement, and compression settings limit generalization; a benchmark model is not a deployment guarantee.

claims.claim: The paper reports acoustic and articulatory findings for the affected speakers and comparison conditions.
claims.limitations: Cohort, anatomy, language, tasks, imaging or motion measures, and acoustic metrics limit clinical generalization; similarity is not a diagnosis.

claims.claim: The paper reports improved handling of laughter and speech-laugh in the tested ASR transcripts.
claims.limitations: Annotation scheme, language, laughter types, model, data mixture, and transcript use case bound the result; event recognition is not a full emotion or intent analysis.

claims.claim: The paper reports attack success and clean-task behavior for the tested compression-based backdoor.
claims.limitations: Model, compression, trigger, target class, defenses, and threat model bound the claim; one attack does not establish universal vulnerability.

claims.claim: The paper reports multilingual ASR accuracy and efficiency results for LoRA language experts.
claims.limitations: Languages, data balance, rank, routing, base model, and evaluation domains bound the claim; parameter efficiency does not guarantee fairness across languages.

claims.claim: The paper reports perceptual and signal-quality improvements for refined front-end outputs.
claims.limitations: Front-end types, distortion, training targets, listeners, metrics, and content preservation bound the result; quality improvement is not guaranteed for unseen algorithms.

claims.claim: The paper reports inference-speed gains and quality behavior for speculative speech decoding.
claims.limitations: Tokenization, proposal model, acceptance rate, hardware, speaker/style, and latency measurement bound the result; speedups vary with the workload.

claims.claim: The paper reports mutual-exclusivity behavior and cross-language differences for the tested bilingual grounded models.
claims.limitations: Languages, training data, object stimuli, model architecture, prompt/task design, and bias measure bound the claim; model behavior is not a direct account of child learning.
